candidate_identity.artifact_set_formula: Sort paths; concatenate each path, one TAB byte, lowercase SHA-256 without prefix, and one LF byte; SHA-256 the result.
candidate_identity.aggregate_enforcement: RootBinding-v1 independently enforces the full 22-file aggregate; WorkerResult-v1 artifacts intentionally cover only the seven owned changed paths.

changes.result: open_bound retains descriptors and identities for every lexical ancestor, then validates retained links without reopening a mutable ancestor by pathname.
Absent-store creation uses the retained parent descriptor, validates before and after creation, and removes a newly created leaf if post-creation revalidation fails.
Read, append, clear, and truncated-tail recovery use the retained parent and reject ordinary or symlink ancestor substitution before mutation.
Ordinary ancestor replacement now covers append, read, clear, and recovery, with replacement and retained-path bytes unchanged for lifecycle mutation failures.

commands_and_tests.command: rustfmt --check scoped observability source and races_paths
commands_and_tests.result: All seven changed Rust files were formatted without touching unrelated sources.
27 of 27 observability contract tests passed in the isolated target; unrelated compiler warnings remained outside this lease.
Clear and recovery rejected ordinary ancestor replacement before mutation; replacement and retained bytes were unchanged.
Append and read rejected the replacement; neither replacement nor retained path received first-store bytes.
Parsed and validated against the root-issued lease and work package; ArtifactWorkspace verified the seven changed artifact rows and computed the emitted WorkerResult result_id.

findings.summary: The prior symlink-only test was a false pass because it did not exercise ordinary ancestor replacement before absent-store creation.
The 22-file candidate identity is independently frozen by RootBinding-v1; this typed WorkerResult records only the seven owned changed artifacts.

limitations: This WorkerResult records a confined local-store candidate only; it does not assert source acceptance, public observability integration, product behavior, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
WorkerResult-v1 does not enforce the declared full candidate aggregate; RootBinding-v1 is the authority for the 22-file membership and aggregate.
Effective runtime route is unverified unless runtime metadata exposes it.
